text: Job titles have male and female forms: Lehrer / Lehrerin, Arzt / Ärztin. Job advertisements often add (m/w/d), for männlich, weiblich, divers, to show that all genders may apply.
The first question in many conversations is Was machen Sie beruflich? or Was sind Sie von Beruf?. Do not be surprised if people ask what you study in the first minute.
